newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers Stores May sales off.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers Stores May sales off.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Thursday its same-store sales fell 0.6 percent during May.

The retailer, which operates JW/Jeans West, Coda, Oaktree and J. Riggings stores, said same-store sales fell to $71.2 million for the four weeks ended May 31 from $71.6 million during the same month last year.

Total sales dropped to $76.5 million from $87 million in May of 1996, down 12 percent. The company operated fewer stores during the period, or an average of 1,734 stores compared to 2,073 in May of last year, it said.
On Wednesday, the company said it expected to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization this year.
